mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: Web-based local multiplayer party game platform offering 18 competitive mini-games in free early access. Players use their mobile phones (or gamepads) as controllers, with support for up to 8 players per game, quick action-based rounds of about one minute, and no downloads or installs required. Plans to open the platform to third-party developers and game jams, handling network connectivity and controllers so devs can focus on building multiplayer mini-games.
mentions.problem: Third-party developers would otherwise spend an eternity on networking code and building multiplayer infrastructure; the platform plans to take care of connectivity and controllers so they can focus on developing mini-games.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a web-based local multiplayer party game platform. It's like a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party: https://gamingcouch.com.
